interact.default_detail: 💕 You spend quality time with **{name}**. The bond grows stronger.

explore.detail: You explore the unknown with **{name}** by your side. Nothing can stop this team!
explore.label: Explore together

follow.detail: You let **{name}** take the lead. It puffs with pride and guides you somewhere new.
follow.label: Let it lead the way

rest.detail: You take a break with **{name}** and enjoy a quiet moment together.
rest.label: Take a break

explore_together.intro: **{name}** looks at you with an adventurous glint in its eyes.
explore_together.intro.brave: **{name}** puffs out its chest and gestures toward the unknown with unmatched courage.
explore_together.intro.curious: **{name}** stares intently at a distant hill, then looks at you, then back at the hill. The message is clear.
explore_together.intro.fierce: **{name}** snarls at the wilderness, ready to conquer whatever lies beyond.
explore_together.intro.gentle: **{name}** gently nudges you toward a flower-filled meadow it discovered.
explore_together.intro.grumpy: **{name}** mutters something under its breath but starts walking, checking you're following.
explore_together.intro.loyal: **{name}** stays by your side but keeps glancing at a path it wants to explore together.
explore_together.intro.mischievous: **{name}** pretends to run away, then circles back behind you and scares you playfully.
explore_together.intro.playful: **{name}** dashes toward the horizon, stops, looks back, dashes further , a clear invitation!
explore_together.intro.sleepy: **{name}** yawns, stretches, and points a paw at a nearby cave before yawning again.
explore_together.intro.timid: **{name}** peeks around a corner, ears perked, then hides behind your legs.

bath.detail: Bath time! **{name}** splashes everywhere but emerges clean and fluffy.
bath.label: Give a bath

brush.detail: You brush **{name}**'s coat until it shines. It practically purrs with happiness.
brush.label: Brush its fur

massage.detail: You massage **{name}**'s tired muscles. It melts into a puddle of relaxation.
massage.label: Give a massage

grooming.intro: **{name}** seems to be asking for some grooming attention.
grooming.intro.brave: **{name}** returns from battle covered in scars and dirt, standing proudly , but could use a clean.
grooming.intro.curious: **{name}** examines its own reflection in a puddle and tries to fix its messy fur.
grooming.intro.fierce: **{name}** growls at a brush, then reluctantly allows a single stroke.
grooming.intro.gentle: **{name}** sits down and looks at you, then at its fur, then back at you with hopeful eyes.
grooming.intro.grumpy: **{name}** has leaves stuck in its fur. It pretends not to care, but keeps glancing at them.
grooming.intro.loyal: **{name}** brings you a brush and sits perfectly still, trusting you completely.
grooming.intro.mischievous: **{name}** shakes vigorously right next to you, spraying water everywhere, then grins.
grooming.intro.playful: **{name}** rolls in the mud, then proudly presents its filthy self to you.
grooming.intro.sleepy: **{name}** has bedhead and doesn't seem to notice. Or care.
grooming.intro.timid: **{name}** approaches with a tangled coat, looking embarrassed.

fetch.detail: You throw the stick. **{name}** zooms after it, returning with tail wagging furiously!
fetch.label: Play fetch

ignore.detail: You gently pet **{name}**, and it leans into your hand, perfectly content.
ignore.label: Pet it gently

tug.detail: You engage in an epic tug of war. **{name}** pulls with all its might, and you let it win.
tug.label: Tug of war

play_time.intro: **{name}** drops a stick at your feet and looks up at you expectantly!
play_time.intro.brave: **{name}** stands tall and presents a stick like a warrior offering a sacred sword!
play_time.intro.curious: **{name}** tilts its head and presents a strange object it found, waiting for your reaction.
play_time.intro.fierce: **{name}** drops a chewed-up stick and growls playfully, challenging you to a game!
play_time.intro.gentle: **{name}** gently places its favorite toy in your lap and looks at you with trusting eyes.
play_time.intro.grumpy: **{name}** sighs dramatically and nudges a toy toward you with a reluctant paw.
play_time.intro.loyal: **{name}** brings you its most prized possession , a shiny rock it's been saving.
play_time.intro.mischievous: **{name}** darts around you in circles, then pretends to hide something behind its back.
play_time.intro.playful: **{name}** drops a stick at your feet and wags excitedly, eyes sparkling with anticipation!
play_time.intro.sleepy: **{name}** half-opens one eye, weakly wagging a toy while clearly half-asleep.
play_time.intro.timid: **{name}** places a small leaf at your feet, then hides behind a bush, peeking out nervously.

investigate.detail: You and **{name}** carefully investigate. It turns out to be a false alarm, but you're glad you checked.
investigate.label: Investigate together

retreat.detail: You wisely retreat with **{name}**. Safety first , there will be other battles.
retreat.label: Retreat to safety

stand_together.detail: You stand shoulder to shoulder with **{name}** against the unknown. United, you're unstoppable.
stand_together.label: Stand together

rescue.intro: **{name}** senses danger and takes a protective stance.
rescue.intro.brave: **{name}** runs to you, then turns and growls at something in the bushes. Something is out there.
rescue.intro.curious: **{name}** discovered a trapped animal and is trying to free it, looking at you for help.
rescue.intro.fierce: **{name}** bares its teeth at a shady figure lurking nearby. It won't back down.
rescue.intro.gentle: **{name}** found a wounded little creature and gently nudges it toward you for help.
rescue.intro.grumpy: **{name}** sighs and deals with the threat efficiently, then gives you a 'you owe me' look.
rescue.intro.loyal: **{name}** blocks your path, refusing to let you proceed. Danger ahead.
rescue.intro.mischievous: **{name}** pranks the threat so thoroughly it runs away confused and embarrassed.
rescue.intro.playful: **{name}** thinks the dangerous situation is a game. You need to handle this carefully.
rescue.intro.sleepy: **{name}** yawns, lazily scares off the threat with a single look, then goes back to napping.
rescue.intro.timid: **{name}** tremblingly stands between you and a strange creature, protecting you despite its fear.

cook.detail: You whip up something delicious. **{name}** watches every step, drooling slightly.
cook.label: Cook something special

feed_treat.detail: You give **{name}** a special treat. It savors every bite, looking at you with pure gratitude.
feed_treat.label: Give a treat

share_meal.detail: You share your meal with **{name}**. It wags happily , sharing is caring!
share_meal.label: Share your meal

snack_time.intro: **{name}** looks at you with big, hopeful eyes near the food bowl.
snack_time.intro.brave: **{name}** bravely faces the empty bowl, determined to wait for its next meal without complaint.
snack_time.intro.curious: **{name}** sniffs the air and follows an invisible scent trail, eventually ending up at its food bowl.
snack_time.intro.fierce: **{name}** attacks its food bowl with relentless fury, winning the battle bite by bite.
snack_time.intro.gentle: **{name}** waits politely by its bowl, never rushing, always grateful.
snack_time.intro.grumpy: **{name}** glares at its food bowl, then at you, clearly unimpressed with today's menu.
snack_time.intro.loyal: **{name}** saves half its food and pushes the bowl toward you, offering to share.
snack_time.intro.mischievous: **{name}** tips its bowl over, then acts surprised, as if it magically emptied itself.
snack_time.intro.playful: **{name}** pats its empty food bowl and gives you the most dramatic hungry eyes you've ever seen!
snack_time.intro.sleepy: **{name}** sleepwalks to the food bowl, eats while napping, then wanders back.
snack_time.intro.timid: **{name}** approaches its bowl hesitantly, looking back at you for reassurance before eating.

interact.title: 💬 {name} wants your attention!

praise.detail: You heap praise on **{name}**. It puffs up with pride, happier than any treat could make it.
praise.label: Praise its effort

spar.detail: You spar with **{name}**. It's getting faster, stronger , your training is paying off!
spar.label: Spar with it

teach.detail: You teach **{name}** a new trick. It concentrates hard and eventually nails it!
teach.label: Teach a new move

training.intro: **{name}** wants to train and is looking at you expectantly.
training.intro.brave: **{name}** strikes a fighting pose and challenges you to a sparring match!
training.intro.curious: **{name}** watches your movements carefully, trying to learn new techniques.
training.intro.fierce: **{name}** is panting heavily, but its eyes burn with the desire to keep training.
training.intro.gentle: **{name}** spars gently, pulling its punches to avoid hurting you.
training.intro.grumpy: **{name}** grumbles but gets into position. Fine. ONE more round.
training.intro.loyal: **{name}** mimics your every move perfectly, wanting to make you proud.
training.intro.mischievous: **{name}** keeps trying to trip you during training, giggling each time.
training.intro.playful: **{name}** turns training into a game, bouncing around you with endless energy.
training.intro.sleepy: **{name}** falls asleep mid-training session, snoring cutely.
training.intro.timid: **{name}** is shaking but stands its ground, determined to improve.
